explanation: Merges main (#99) into the HypoMap atlas build. From main: CONTEXT.md's explorer entry says the changelog closes when a visit ends while the study-details disclosure outlives it, naming changelogVisit.test.tsx. From this branch: package.json adds build:hypomap and test:hypomap-build, .gitignore excludes data/hypomap/source/ and data/hypomap/build/, hypomap-release.json pins the reproducible hypomap-atlas-2026-11-26, the Application workflow runs the synthetic-H5AD exporter test, and PROJECT_GUIDANCE lists the HypoMap sources among files not in the repository. Review fixes: hypomap-release.json is re-pinned to the rebuilt archive (manifest b8bc4809..., archive e2e6aa47...), and test:hypomap-build now also checks the tracked study card against its pin, fixed gzip bytes and LF-only JSON.
